value.answer: Mostly the kids' rec side: registration dates for swim and skate programs, drop-in times at nearby rec centres, and the spots that fill up fast. For Wren and Tomas that means the kinds of things that slip past busy parents, not anything about their day-to-day. I can't say yet what I'd find until I'm set up.
